Product Description

Please note: The buyer is responsible for customs clearance and payment of duties.

If you have other configuration needs, you can contact us and we will customize it for you.


Supermicro H12SSL-i Motherboard With AMD EPYC 7742 64 Cores 2.25GHz Server CPU


 


Package include:

1x AMD EPYC 7742 CPU

1x Supermicro H12SSL-i motherboard



Product SKUs

MBD-H12SSL-i
  • H12SSL-i
MBD-H12SSL-i-O
  • H12SSL-i (Retail Pack)

Physical Stats

Form Factor
  • ATX
Dimensions
  • 12" x 9.6" (30.5cm x 24.4cm)

Processor/Chipset

CPU
  • Single AMD EPYC™ 7003/7002 Series Processor
    (7003 Series Processor drop-in support requires BIOS version 2.0 or newer)
  • Socket SP3
Cores
  • Up to 64 Cores
Chipset
  • System on Chip

System Memory

Memory Capacity
  • 8 DIMM slots
  • Supports up to 2TB Registered ECC DDR4 3200MHz SDRAM
  • 8-channel memory bus
Memory Type
  • DDR4 3200 MHz Registered ECC, 288-pin gold-plated DIMMs
DIMM Sizes
  • 8GB, 16GB, 32GB, 64GB, 128GB, 256GB
Memory Voltage
  • 1.2V
Error Detection
  • Corrects single-bit errors
  • Detects double-bit errors (using ECC memory)

On-Board Devices

SATA
  • SATA3 (6 Gbps)
IPMI
  • Support for Intelligent Platform Management Interface v.2.0
  • IPMI 2.0 with virtual media over LAN and KVM-over-LAN support
  • ASPEED AST2500 BMC
Network Controllers
  • Dual gigabit LAN via Broadcom BCM5720
  • 1 Realtek RTL8211F PHY (dedicated IPMI)
VGA
  • ASPEED AST2500 BMC

Input / Output

SATA
  • 8 SATA3 (6 Gbps) ports
SATA/NVMe Hybrid
  • 8 SATA3 or 2 NVMe via single SlimSAS x8
LAN
  • 2 RJ45 Gigabit Ethernet LAN ports
  • 1 RJ45 Dedicated IPMI LAN port
USB
  • 6 USB 3.0 ports
    (4 rear + 2 via header)
VGA
  • 1 VGA port
Others
  • 1 COM port (rear)
  • 2 SATA DOM power connectors
  • 1 TPM 2.0 header

Expansion Slots

PCI-Express
  • 5 PCI-E 4.0 x16
  • 2 PCI-E 4.0 x8

M.2
  • Interface: 2 PCI-E 4.0 x4
  • Form factor: 2280, 22110
  • Key: M-key

Chassis ( Optimized for H12SSL-i )

1U
  • SC813MFTQC-350CB2
  • SC813MFTQC-R407CB
2U
  • SC213BAC8-R1K23LPB
  • SC216BE1C4-R1K23LPB
  • SC825MBTQC-R802LPB
  • SC825TQC-R802LPB
  • SC826BE1C4-R1K23LPB
  • SCLA26AC12-R920LP1
3U
  • SC835TQC-R802B
  • SC836BE1C-R1K23B
Mid-Tower
  • SC732i-903B
Tower/4U
  • SC745BAC-R1K23B
  • SC846BE1C-R1K23B


Server(s) ( with H12SSL-i )

Model(s)
  • AS -2014S-TR
  • AS -3014TS-i

System BIOS

BIOS Type
  • AMI 256Mb SPI Flash EEPROM
BIOS Features
  • Plug and Play (PnP)
  • DMI 2.3
  • PCI 2.2
  • ACPI 5.1
  • USB Keyboard Support
  • SMBIOS 3.1.1

Management

Software
  • Super Doctor 5
  • Watch Dog
  • NMI
  • SUM
  • IPMI 2.0, KVM with dedicated LAN
Power Configurations
  • ACPI Power Management
  • Power-on mode control for AC power loss recovery

PC Health Monitoring

CPU
  • Monitors CPU Core Voltages, +3.3V, +5V, +5V standby, +3.3V standby
  • CPU switching voltage regulator
  • Supports system management utility
  • VBAT
FAN
  • Up to 7-fan status tachometer monitoring
  • Up to 7 4-pin fan headers
  • Dual Cooling Zone
  • Status monitor for speed control
  • Pulse Width Modulated (PWM) fan connectors
Temperature
  • Monitoring for CPU and chassis environment
  • CPU Thermal Trip Support
  • Thermal control for 7x Fan connectors
  • I²C Temperature Sensing Logic
LED
  • CPU / System Overheat LED
Other Features
  • Chassis Intrusion Detection
  • Chassis Intrusion Header
  • UID


Operating Environment / Compliance

Environmental Specifications
  • Operating Temperature:
    10°C to 35°C (50°F to 95°F)
  • Non-operating Temperature:
    -40°C to 70°C (-40°F to 158°F)
  • Operating Relative Humidity:
    8% to 90% (non-condensing)
  • Non-operating Relative Humidity:
    5% to 95% (non-condensing)

seller_feedback.feedback_text: Excellent.  I'm always leery about buying from overseas, but this was amazingly fast: 2 days from Hong Kong by Fedex.  Well packaged, perfect condition $1300 motherboard.  Seller responsive.  Will be my go-to for buying computer equipment from China from now on.

Fantastic seller — the MC62-G40 arrived in excellent packaging, clearly well protected for shipping. Board was in great condition and came complete with everything including the I/O plate. Really happy with the overall purchase. Had a question about the BMC/IPMI setup and the seller responded quickly and was super helpful in resolving it. Would absolutely buy from again. Highly recommended!

Then item arrived as stated and is working. I had a few questions and they were helpful and replied promptly. I would buy from this seller. Also the packaging was good and the shipping was pretty quick.

Made a mistake during the order. Determined afterwards that the motherboard model possibly didn't meet my needs, so I cancelled the order before it was shipped (apologies for my error and thank you).

The seller promptly greenlit my refund.

Great experience. I can see why they have such good ratings. For used/openbox items that I can't find locally and that must be shipped overseas, I would definitely prioritze this seller.

Good seller and a smooth transaction overall. The board arrived well and was exactly as described. Installed it into a new build and it POSTed first try — passed full memory testing and an extended stress test with zero errors. Fully functional and rock solid. Communication was prompt and helpful throughout. Very happy with the purchase and would recommend!

Condition was excellent, and exactly as described - very slight signs of use (dust, a few specs of thermal paste residue), but absolutely no damage or scratches.

Shipping was fast and received the product sooner than I had expected.
Very well packaged for shipping, with several layers of bubble wrap, double boxed, and protected.

My only nitpick is the M.2 standoffs had been removed from the board but other than that, it booted up and worked perfectly without a fight.
Amazing seller communication, fast shipping, great value, and everything arrived in fantastic condition. I was worried about internationally ordering GPUs but this seller is A++++++!
Good contact, seller responds to questions within a day or two. Item extremely well packed. Working great, very fast. Good trustworthy seller. I would definitely buy from them again.
